name: t1w-template_precise
title: Precise T1w-to-template registration
intended_for: Brain-extracted T1w to a brain-extracted T1w template (e.g. MNI152NLin2009cAsym res-01) at about 1 mm. Not for EPI-to-T1w, low-resolution, or non-brain data: CC radius 4 over five levels assumes that resolution and field of view.
provenance: Schedule from bbuchsbaum/niflowr#29, shaped like niworkflows' precise T1w-to-MNI preset. With antsx/ants:v2.6.5 it matched fMRIPrep 25.x's T1w-to-MNI152NLin2009cAsym transform on two MSC participants (MI, CC, and brain-mask Dice within noise of fMRIPrep's, differences of either sign; query-target error median 0.19 mm, p95 0.75 mm, all 825 targets), where antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t s left a 3.62 mm median error.
cost: About 17 min with 8 threads for a 1 mm T1w to MNI152NLin2009cAsym res-01, roughly 2.4 times antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t s.
